title: Verify Cursor ACP in an isolated fixture
description: Test the installed Cursor CLI through a minimal disposable ACP client. Verify initialize, authentication status, session creation, streaming, permission requests, cancellation and load/resume capability. Handle Cursor blocking extensions such as ask_question and create_plan explicitly. Use a temporary fixture, not user projects. Local inspection found Cursor 2026.11.17-f532c45 and agent acp --help, but no authenticated session has been tested.
why: Native ACP support still needs a local compatibility check.

acceptance.text: Record exact version and launch arguments
A harmless prompt streams to completion
Denied permission and cancellation do not hang
Capability and unsupported-extension behavior are recorded
